Review_Text: Great app for beginners. Very smooth UI.
Why was ₹15.93 deducted from my account when I sold my shares? Groww says zero brokerage but they are charging hidden fees every time I sell! Very confusing.
The app keeps lagging during market open hours. Please fix the servers.
Good mutual fund options but customer support takes 3 days to reply.
Groww claims no hidden charges, but I noticed a DP charge being deducted on my sell orders. This was not clearly communicated when I signed up.
I hate that every time I sell even a single stock, ₹15.93 is gone as a Depository Participant charge. Needs better transparency on the sell screen.
